mainEntity.name: Can you fix a bathroom leak without hacking the tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer no-hack solutions using PU Injection from the ceiling below, or applying a clear, penetrative Nano-coating over the existing tiles to seal the grout lines.

mainEntity.name: How much does PU Injection cost in Kuala Lumpur?

acceptedAnswer.text: PU Injection is charged per injection point, typically ranging from RM 150 to RM 300 per point, depending on the severity of the crack and accessibility.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide a warranty for waterproofing work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We provide a formal warranty between 1 to 10 years depending on the waterproofing method applied (e.g., full Torch-On Membrane vs. localized PU injection).
Torch-On Membrane is a heavy-duty waterproofing system using sheets of modified bitumen that are melted onto concrete surfaces using a blowtorch. It is the best solution for flat RC roofs.
